title: Nozzle-Clog Warning from Extrusion Skips
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), Klipper resonance metrics (`klipper:telemetry`), resin print logs (`resinprint:job`), tool usage (`tool:usage`), filament inventory (`filament:spool`), and workshop air readings (`workshop:air`).
app: Maker telemetry from OctoPrint, Moonraker, printer firmware sensors, resin printer job logs, smart dryboxes, and workshop tool sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=printer:telemetry
| stats avg(extrusion_skip_pct) as avg_skip_pct max(extrusion_skip_pct) as max_skip_pct by printer nozzle
| where max_skip_pct>5
| sort - max_skip_pct
description: Highlights printers showing elevated extrusion-skip percentages that often precede a clog or partial blockage.
value: Extrusion skips are an early sign of filament path trouble, letting you intervene before a long job turns into a spaghetti failure.
implementation: Stream skip or missed-step telemetry from firmware dashboards, toolhead sensors, or post-processed motion logs.
visualization: Table of printers with average and peak extrusion-skip percentages.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when a printer starts struggling to push filament through the nozzle before a bigger jam ruins a job.
